sources.label: Morphe Patches
sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: Allow screenshots
Lets you take screenshots and record the screen on every screen of the app. Some screens, such as sharing a health summary, block them.
Black theme
Makes the background and cards pure black instead of dark gray in the dark theme, which saves battery on OLED screens. Buttons, charts and pop-ups keep their colors.
Clone app

Changes the package name, so the patched app installs next to the official Google Health app instead of replacing it. Both apps sign in on their own. Push notifications don't work in the clone, and a watch or tracker can only be paired wit…
Disable review prompts
Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.
Disable surveys
Stops the app from asking Google for surveys, such as "How satisfied are you with Google Health?", so none are shown.
Disable update prompts
Stops the app from asking you to update it from Google Play. A patched app can't be updated from Google Play; patch the new version instead.
GmsCore support

Makes signing in work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in through Play services, because it is no longer signed by Google. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it.
Hide Medical records
Hides Medical records in the account menu and on the Connections screen. Medical records only work with US healthcare providers.
Hide Premium offer sheets
Hides the sheets that pop up to offer Premium, such as the 3 months of Premium offer and the reminder that your Premium trial is ending. Premium itself keeps working.
Hide Shop devices
Hides the Shop devices button on the Connections screen, which opens the Google Store.
Open links in browser
Opens links, such as the Google Store, in your browser instead of a browser tab inside the app.
Spoof installer
Reports Google Play as the app installer, so the app doesn't treat the patched app as installed from an unknown source.
